description: Send tokens directly to an address (no x402, no provider). Subject to the user's guardrail. Solana supports any SPL token: USDC, USDT, wSOL, mSOL, JitoSOL, BONK, JUP, PYTH, or any mint address. EVM supports the network's stablecoin only: USDC, or USDT0 on Stable (network "stable", chain 988). Pass private:true on Solana to route through MagicBlock's Private Ephemeral Rollup, which obscures the amount and recipient via delayed execution + fund splitting.

amount.description: Token amount in human units, e.g. 1.5 or 1000.

network.description: Force network if address is ambiguous.

private.description: Route through MagicBlock Private Ephemeral Rollup for on-chain privacy (Solana only).

token.description: Token symbol (USDC, BONK, JUP, wSOL, …) or Solana mint address. Defaults to USDC.

name: xpay_transfer
